result.note: Weekly round-up with little hard detail; tested only the location of the US blockade of Iranian oil and India's diplomatic response, skipping the unclear Putin sanctions line.

questions.prompt: In June 2026, three sailors were killed as a United States blockade of Iranian oil hit tankers crewed by Indians. In which water body was this blockade being enforced?
questions.explain: The story places the enforcement of Washington's blockade of Iranian oil in the Gulf of Oman. Within seven days it affected three foreign-flagged tankers crewed by Indians, and the three deaths were the first since the campaign began.
questions.source: Washington's blockade of Iranian oil, enforced in the Gulf of Oman, ran through three foreign-flagged tankers crewed by Indians in seven days, and by Friday it had killed three sailors, the first deaths since the campaign began.

questions.prompt: In June 2026, Indian sailors were killed during a United States blockade of Iranian oil. Consider the following statements:
items: The tankers that were hit were Indian-flagged vessels.
India responded with a formal protest and summoned a diplomat.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 1 is wrong because the tankers were foreign-flagged, though crewed by Indians. New Delhi moved from silence on Wednesday, when it would not even name the United States, to a formal protest and a summoned diplomat on Friday, which TBB calls the ceiling of what it will risk.
questions.source: New Delhi moved from Wednesday's studied silence, refusing even to name the United States, to Friday's formal protest and a summoned diplomat, the ceiling of what it will risk.
